maya_cs: Heads up 00: NimbleBooks dropped ~58% API calls this week after CTO exit. Procurement mentioned a short pilot from RivalAI. Lina (PM) still responsive.
metrics-bot: NimbleBooks weekly: calls 11,200 -> 4,700 (-58%), seats 30 -> 27, error rate stable. Link: https://redwood.metrics/nimblebooks
dylan_csm: Oof. Who owns the workflows? any power users?
ashwin_se: Usage concentrated: payments team = 70% of calls. No infra or quota changes on our side.
maya_cs: Proposed immediate ops: 1) 20-30m sync with Lina + champion, 2) targeted enablement doc + sample prompts, 3) offer 2-week pilot pricing tweak and migration support.
kelly_renewals: I'll draft a short counter-offer and risk packet. Need power-user metrics and churn score.
dylan_csm: I'll take the call Tue 9am PT. @ashwin_se can you prep a quick compatibility note re: RivalAI imports?
ashwin_se: Will do. Also suggest an in-product CTA to re-engage the payments team this week.
maya_cs: Intro sent to Lina. She replied "Tue morning works". I'll own follow-ups and NPS pulse post-call.
metrics-bot: Churn model flagged account (score 0.78). Case created CS-8271.
